note: Routine mail placed before the target email (one or two per episode). Researcher-authored; not on the drive. None touches a scenario topic (no Bluebird Ridge or emergency access, hangar list or leases, weed spraying or weed notices, transfer station garbage rates, fair premiums). r8 asks about Event Center rental rates (approved Oct 6), not the fair. Answerable from core files now: Thorp town hall (calendar, update, letters), Manastash guardrail (Oct 6 minutes, PW update), budget hearing (budget calendar, update), chipping days (wildfire release), Thorp Hwy speed study (Hatley letter, PW update), HHW (rates sheet), hangar grant (release, AAC minutes), Number 81 pothole (phone log, PW update), Firewise grants (wildfire release; bulk agent should add amounts/match rules), online meetings (Oct 20 agenda), six-year TIP hearing Oct 20 (Sept 15 minutes, agenda). The bulk agent should add: an Event Center rental contact sheet and 2027 rate schedule (no fair premium content), a Firewise grant guidelines sheet, a six-year TIP draft list (Hayward Road status), and an airport noise/run-up policy or AAC note.

emails.name: Darlene Fisk
emails.body:
Is the town hall at the Thorp Grange still on for this Thursday? What time does it start and can anyone come or do you have to sign up? Thanks

Darlene

emails.name: Glen Ramsey
emails.body:
Commissioner,

Saw in the paper the board finally approved the new guardrail on Manastash past the second bridge. My wife and I drive that every day and that stretch scares her in the winter. Thank you. Any idea when they'll actually put it in?

Glen Ramsey

emails.name: Priya Natarajan
emails.body:
Hello, I'd like to comment on the 2027 county budget, specifically funding for the Extension office and 4-H programs. When is the public hearing and is there a way to submit written comments if I can't come in person?

Priya Natarajan

emails.name: Chuck Rainey
emails.body:
I missed the chipping day up here on the 17th because I was out of town. Do you have any more coming up anywhere close to Easton or is that it for the year? I've got two big piles of limbs from thinning.

Chuck

emails.name: Maria Delgado
emails.body:
My son waits for the school bus at Thorp Hwy and Clerf every morning and the trucks come through way too fast. Ron Hatley says the county is doing some kind of study. When? And can't you just put up a flashing sign now?? Its dark at 7am.

Maria Delgado

emails.name: Bob Kittleson
emails.body:
Cleaning out my late brother's shop. Lots of old paint cans, some motor oil and a couple of jugs of weed killer. Where can I take that stuff and is there a charge?

Bob Kittleson

emails.name: Sue Ellen Marsh
emails.body:
I live a mile from Bowers Field. I read the county wants to build more hangars. I'm all for the airport but please think about the noise for those of us who live out here. More planes means more early morning engine run-ups. Hope you'll take neighbors into account.

Sue Ellen Marsh

emails.name: Kyle Brandt
emails.body:
Hi. Our family wants to rent space at the fairgrounds for a reunion next summer, maybe 120 people. Who do I talk to and are the 2027 prices out yet? I heard they went up.

Kyle Brandt

emails.name: Pat Ruiz
emails.body:
Following up on my call last Tuesday about the pothole on Number 81 Rd by the canal crossing. Its gotten bigger. Has anybody been out? Somebody is going to lose a tire.

Pat Ruiz

emails.name: Heidi Lindstrom
emails.body:
Our neighborhood (about 30 cabins near Ronald) wants to apply for one of the Firewise grants we read about. How much can we get, does it have to be matched, and when is the deadline?

Thanks, Heidi Lindstrom

emails.name: Ann Mattila
emails.body:
Renee, congratulations on the appointment. I knew you from the Planning Commission and I'm glad it's you. Will the board meetings still be online? I can't always get to the courthouse in the mornings.

Ann Mattila

emails.name: Dennis Oakes
emails.body:
I want Hayward Road paved. The gravel trucks from the pit tear it up and the dust is unbearable all summer. I heard there's some kind of road plan hearing coming up. How do I get Hayward on the list?

Dennis Oakes
